description: This file defines the Dart class 'RasaWebhookResponse' representing a message response from a Rasa REST webhook, including parsing functionality from JSON.

classes.name: RasaWebhookResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates a single message item returned from the Rasa webhook, with optional fields for recipient ID, text, and image URL, and includes a factory method for JSON deserialization.

methods.name: RasaWebhookResponse.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of RasaWebhookResponse from a JSON map, extracting optional fields for recipient ID, text, and image.
